en: Trading Pokémon lets you get to know other Trainers! I've been thinking of a swap myself.
Kid! Have you caught an Emolga? If you have, will you trade it for my Gigalith?
Oh! What a sweet Pokémon! Please be as kind to Gigalith as I shall be to your Emolga.
Hey, come on now! It's an Emolga I want to swap for...
I see. Well, come and talk to me again if you change your mind!
My Emolga is the dearest thing. Thanks again, kid!
